method: Re-open each upstream Wikimedia Commons file page, verify the license statement/author-source description currently shown there, and cross-check each artifact provenance source_sha256 against the pinned expected_sha256 in PR #6's source registry. This is provenance QA, not legal advice and not creative/listening approval.

sources.title: Waves.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader describes own recordings made with a shotgun microphone on the shores of Lake Ontario in Webster, New York.
sources.creativeRisk: Freshwater/Lake Ontario source is not inherently tropical/oceanic; human review must confirm surf identity and perspective before Beach OceanNear/Far/ShoreWash approval.

sources.title: Rain.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader describes an own recording of rain.
sources.creativeRisk: Generic rain source; human review still needs to check enclosure/handling identity and tropical-storm fit.

sources.title: Rain (1).ogg
sources.sourceDescription: PDSounds rain recording attributed to ezwa and released to the public domain by the author.
sources.creativeRisk: Generic source; intensity/material-space suitability remains a listening question.

sources.title: Howling wind.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader explicitly describes the source as wind howling in a building.
sources.creativeRisk: HIGH: indoor/building resonance may read as architectural/interior wind rather than exposed tropical outdoor storm wind. Requires explicit space-identity listening review; license correctness does not solve this fit risk.

sources.title: Fire.ogv
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader describes own work as a campfire.
sources.creativeRisk: Source subject matches campfire intent, but PR #6's Idle/Low derivatives remain separately flagged for extreme objective similarity and loop-seam review.

sources.title: Walk in the rainforest.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: PDSounds source described as a walk in the Guadeloupean rainforest with bird/birdsong tags.
sources.creativeRisk: Geographic/biome fit is promising, but bird identity and any movement/footstep contamination must be checked before a persistent jungle bed is approved.

sources.title: 蝉鸣.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader describes an own cicada recording made at Qingfengshan.
sources.creativeRisk: Specific locale/species signature may be recognizable; human biome-fit review remains required before tropical-island use.

sources.title: Tonitrus.ogg
sources.sourceDescription: Uploader describes thunder recorded in Southern Finland on Minidisc.
sources.creativeRisk: Thunder is less geography-specific than fauna, but tail/noise/source-artifact and tropical-storm fit still require listening review.

rules: A verified source-page license claim is provenance evidence, not legal advice or a guarantee that no non-copyright rights apply.
License/provenance correctness does not imply material, biome, perspective or loop suitability.
Every candidate remains candidate-headset-listen until the required human/Quest gates are completed.
PR #6 must synchronize current main and refresh any affected payload pin before authoritative physical evidence.
